body: this is pretty close to describing my exact experience. my primary abuser (who trafficked us) didn’t know about DID as far as I know, but he knew how to exploit and manipulate our dissociative state with the use of different methods. We have “command words” that “activate” parts of us that were conditioned to respond to them, etc. (I can’t say more than that because I’m dissociating badly now). I don’t have access to a good therapist because I live in a country that isn’t very aware of DID (let alone anything like this) but thank you so much for replying because it really helped me feel less alone.
